questions.q: What is Ghaemi's thesis about mental illness and leadership?
a: Certain illnesses can bring benefits for leaders
questions.why: The overview says depression and bipolar disorder may help in leadership.

questions.q: Why might depressed people be better leaders, per lesson 1?
a: They tend to be more empathetic
questions.why: Lesson 1 says depression can lead to greater empathy.

questions.q: Which pair of leaders does lesson 2 say struggled with depression from childhood?
a: Martin Luther King Jr. and Gandhi
questions.why: Lesson 2 says King and Gandhi both suffered from depression starting young.

questions.q: What did the civil rights movements of King and Gandhi share at their core?
questions.why: The summary calls them radical empathy.

questions.q: What does lesson 3 suggest for reducing stigma around mental illness?
a: Accept the struggles of past leaders and their contributions
questions.why: Lesson 3 says we must admit leaders' conditions and their positive contributions.
